module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Brennan's Conjecture

*Reference:*
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brennan_conjecture)
- [arXiv:2409.15074](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15074)
- [arXiv:2512.09330](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09330)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace BrennanConjecture

open Complex Filter MeasureTheory Set Topology

def unitDisk : Set ℂ := {z | ‖z‖ < 1}

/-- The standard class $\mathcal{S}$ of normalised univalent functions on $\mathbb{D}$. -/
structure IsUnivalentNormalized (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  analyticOn : AnalyticOn ℂ f unitDisk
  injOn      : InjOn f unitDisk
  map_zero   : f 0 = 0
  deriv_zero : deriv f 0 = 1

/-- $\beta_f(\tau) := \limsup_{r \to 1^-}
\frac{\log \int_{-\pi}^{\pi} |f'(re^{i\theta})|^\tau \, d\theta}{|\log(1-r)|}$ -/
noncomputable def integralMeansSpectrum (f : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  limsup
    (fun r => Real.log (∫ θ in Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
        ‖deriv f (r • exp (Complex.I * θ))‖ ^ τ) /
      |Real.log (1 - r)|)
    (𝓝[Iio 1] (1 : ℝ))

noncomputable def universalSpectrum (τ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {β | ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, IsUnivalentNormalized f ∧ β = integralMeansSpectrum f τ}

noncomputable def universalSpectrumBounded (τ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {β | ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, IsUnivalentNormalized f ∧
    Bornology.IsBounded (f '' unitDisk) ∧ β = integralMeansSpectrum f τ}

@[category API, AMS 30]
theorem universalSpectrumBounded_le (τ : ℝ) :
    universalSpectrumBounded τ ≤ universalSpectrum τ := by
  apply csSup_le_csSup
  · sorry
  · sorry
  · rintro β ⟨f, hf, _, rfl⟩; exact ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩

@[category test, AMS 30]
theorem integralMeansSpectrum_id (τ : ℝ) : integralMeansSpectrum id τ = 0 := by
  sorry

/-- Brennan's conjecture, part 1: $B(-2) = 1$. -/
@[category research open, AMS 30]
theorem brennan_universalSpectrum :
    universalSpectrum (-2) = 1 := by
  sorry

/-- Brennan's conjecture, part 2: $B_b(-2) = 1$. -/
@[category research open, AMS 30]
theorem brennan_universalSpectrumBounded :
    universalSpectrumBounded (-2) = 1 := by
  sorry

/-- Brennan's conjecture, part 3: $B(-2) = B_b(-2)$. -/
@[category API, AMS 30]
theorem brennan_spectra_eq :
    universalSpectrum (-2) = universalSpectrumBounded (-2) := by
  rw [brennan_universalSpectrum, brennan_universalSpectrumBounded]

/-- Brennan's conjecture: $B(-2) = B_b(-2) = 1$. -/
@[category API, AMS 30]
theorem brennan :
    universalSpectrum (-2) = 1 ∧ universalSpectrumBounded (-2) = 1 :=
  ⟨brennan_universalSpectrum, brennan_universalSpectrumBounded⟩

end BrennanConjecture

reformulations.difference: Uses the integral-means formulation B(-2)=B_b(-2)=1 rather than Wikipedia's integrability statement for conformal maps into the disk. This spectral formulation appears explicitly in the cited Jin paper.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For f=φ⁻¹, change of variables gives ∫_W |φ′|^p = ∫_D |f′|^(2-p), taking 4/3<p<4 to -2<q<2/3. Affine normalization preserves finiteness and integral-means spectra. Convexity and continuity of β_f, with β_f(0)=0 and the classical positive-exponent bounds, identify this integrability range with β_f(-2)≤1 for every normalized univalent f. The bounded normalized polynomial f(z)=z-z²/2 has β_f(-2)=1, so the supremum bound is an equality. Makarov's formula B(t)=max{B_b(t),3t-1}, recalled in Jin's §1, also makes the bounded-only formulation equivalent.

sources_consulted: Alexandru Aleman and Athanasios Kouroupis, Brennan's conjecture holds for semigroups of holomorphic functions, arXiv:2409.15074v2, §§1–2. Abstract: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15074 ; LaTeX source: https://arxiv.org/e-print/2409.15074

Jianjun Jin, Complex exponential integral means spectra of univalent functions and the Brennan conjecture, arXiv:2512.09330v13, §§1, 3, 6–7. Abstract: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09330 ; LaTeX source: https://arxiv.org/e-print/2512.09330
review.notes: Checked all 11 declarations. The normalized and bounded classes match the primary source. The real-valued limsup and sSup are legitimate here: the identity makes both classes nonempty, and Koebe distortion gives uniform finite bounds 0≤β_f(τ)≤max{3τ,-τ}. For admissible functions, f′ is nonzero inside the disk and each radial angular integral is finite and positive, so the integral, logarithm and power defaults do not change the statements. Independent checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean compile without sorryAx, including class nonemptiness, disk/holomorphy equivalence, the left-limit boundary checks, β_id(τ)=0, and both universal spectra at τ=0. The consulted sources still describe the full conjecture as open; their proved semigroup and rational-function cases do not settle the declarations here.
